sources.quote: Cyclotron Road – Cyclotron Road Skip to main content Applications are now open until October 30, 2026! Apply now ! The solutions for the challenges of tomorrow are in the hands of today's innovators. We are now accepting applications for Cohort 2027! If you want to take your idea to impact, apply by October 30, 2026. Our program empowers entrepreneurial scientists to take their innovation to impact by offering them knowledge, resources, and connections through a world-class fellowship. Fellows have launched companies across sectors like AI, energy, biomanufacturing, and critical materials that drive innovation and address societal challenges. Our program provides fellows with a living stipend, research funding, entrepreneurial training in collaboration with our non-profit partner Activate, and access to the multidisciplinary expertise and facilities at Lawrence Berkeley National Lab (Berkeley Lab).
